text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 14-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Time back was real. Reps saved about 40 minutes per day on CRM updates and follow-up emails.

2. Data quality improved. Next steps and decision-makers were logged on 90% of calls, up from roughly half.

3. Managers coached better. Reviewing summaries beat ride-alongs for spotting patterns across deals.

4. Trust took work. Reps worried about being recorded until we shared exactly how the notes would be used.

5. Accuracy wasn't perfect. Product names and pricing details still needed a quick human check.

The biggest lesson: the tool didn't change how we sell. It gave reps more time to do it.

Would your team try it?

(Scenario is synthetic; figures are illustrative.)
